verdict.rationale: vLLM's own deployment docs say it ships an official Docker image, vllm/vllm-openai on Docker Hub, which runs the OpenAI-compatible server. That directly covers running the runtime in a container. missing for 10: evidence of version-pinned image tags or custom image builds for reproducibility, independent or hands-on corroboration of container deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime inside a container for reproducible deployment

citations.quote: vLLM offers an official Docker image for deployment. The image can be used to run OpenAI compatible server and is available on Docker Hub as vllm/vllm-openai
